conbody.p: Closed periods are kept for 90 days, after which nobody can reopen them or change their postings.
Back up the ledger database before you close the period, every time, even for a short period.
Open Ledger, select the period that you want to close and check that no entries are still open.
Read the closing checklist before you close the period and send the signed copy to the controller.
Export the trial balance to the reporting folder before you close the period.
Every posting in a closed period keeps the name of the person who approved it and the time of approval.
